Anti-money laundering

AML Investigation Lab

I built an interactive lab to practice investigating AML alerts and checking claims against source records.

Independent project

The problem

Two alerts can show a similar pattern of transfers. To work out what happened, an analyst needs to connect the transactions to business records and see where the evidence stops.

The decision

I used the same synthetic records for the browser demo and four Agent Skills. The browser checks a prepared draft against the records. In Codex and Claude Code, the skills can compare alert rankings, review a case, check ownership or audit a draft you provide.

What you can try

Open a transfer and check whether its source names the person who initiated it. Then remove the settlement record from the other case and see which claim loses support. The demo runs without an API key.
